## About

Hello! 👋 I’m a graduate student in the **M.S. in Learning Engineering program at Carnegie Mellon University’s School of Computer Science**, with a background in **Data Science and Informatics** from the University of California, Irvine. My work sits at the intersection of artificial intelligence, data science, learning research, and human-centered product design.

At UCI’s Digital Learning Lab, I contributed to the **Converse to Learn** and **Generative AI in Education** projects. I built data workflows for AI interaction logs, developed a chat-intent classification framework for more than 4,000 messages, and applied statistical models to understand how learners engage with AI-supported tools. I also co-authored an accepted ICLS 2026 paper examining student behavior in an AI-supported writing environment. 🤖

Beyond research, I have experience developing **LLM-powered applications**, including a retrieval-augmented educational assistant, and translating data into practical recommendations through my project management internship at BOUN Consulting. These experiences strengthened my ability to connect technical development with user needs, stakeholder goals, and real-world implementation.

My interests include **large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, educational AI, NLP, statistical modeling, learning analytics, and AI product development**. I am especially interested in building responsible, transparent, and human-centered AI systems that turn complex data into meaningful products and experiences. 📊🔬
